about: T-459 C: once THE SUBTLE LAYER is held, some turns of a battle open with a lean in the book's purple where "What will X do?" stood -- what the foe will do, read from what it has really chosen, right more often as READ (ATTUNEMENT - VOLTAGE) rises. Counted once the foe's turn comes (VAR_LEANS_TOLD, VAR_LEANS_LANDED). gThreeDebugLean makes one come every turn; the player's daemon's ATTACK and SP. ATK are set to 1 so the wild one lives to take its turns. The theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's.

stops.stop: the book held: a wild battle on ROUTE 22, its first menu -- after the two-second button hint, a lean where the question stood
steps: shot the lean, where the question stood
shot the routines (the lean gone with the question)

stops.stop: a second turn: the count moves again, once the foe has had its turn
without the book: the same battle, the question as it was
